title: List encoding by concatenation
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type, let $f$ assign a finite Boolean string to each element of $\alpha$, and let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. Encoding $l$ by prefixing each encoded element with a one and terminating with a zero gives the concatenation of the strings $1f(a)$ for $a$ in list order, followed by a zero.
hypotheses_covered: A function f from α to finite Boolean strings
A finite list l of elements of α
